Had Ishmael's mother left Zamzam as it was, it would be a flowing stream; she let the Jurhum settle by her on condition they had no right to the water.
Abraham leaves Ishmael and his mother near the Ka'ba; she runs between Safa and Marwa, an angel brings forth Zamzam, Jurhum settle, and Abraham and Ishmael build the Ka'ba.
